name: frontier-board
title: Frontier Board
description: Interactive score-vs-cost scatter where each model's effort levels connect into an efficiency frontier line, with metric/version toggles, model filter, and hover focus.

meta.question: Which model delivers the most score per dollar (or token), and at what effort level?
meta.whenToUse: Comparing models on a quality-vs-cost tradeoff when each model has multiple runs (effort levels / modes) that form a frontier.
meta.antiUse: Needs >=2 runs per model to draw frontier lines; single-point-per-model data reads better as rank-bars.
